text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #fff at 90% opacity. This balances visibility and subtlety—strong enough for keyboard users to track focus without overwhelming the interface. The trade-off is slightly less crisp edges on high-DPI screens, but it avoids the blurrier look of the 3px ring with 1px inner at 80% opacity.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks fading into light backgrounds where #005fcc’s contrast drops below 4.5:1. A 3px ring at 3:1 contrast (e.g., #004494) keeps focus visible on all backgrounds without bulk. Settle it with a live contrast test on 10 light backgrounds.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px solid #004494 focus ring with a 1px inner #fff at 80% opacity. This guarantees 3:1 contrast on light backgrounds while staying crisp on high-DPI screens. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it keeps focus visible for keyboard users without overwhelming the design.

name: Reader
text: The 3px #004494 ring risks visual bulk on high-contrast light backgrounds where #fff inner glow at 80% opacity may still blur focus edges. A 2px #005fcc ring with a 1px #fff inner at 95% opacity hits 4.5:1 contrast on light backgrounds and stays crisp on high-DPI screens—settle it with a live contrast test on 10 light backgrounds.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with 1px inner #fff at 95% opacity—guarantees ≥4.5:1 contrast on light backgrounds, stays crisp on high-DPI, and avoids bulk. Owner: Ramp delivers the final CSS rule and live contrast test results by EOD.
